description: Pool ICL phenotype frequencies across three cohorts with exact binomial CIs and test between-cohort heterogeneity
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Phenotype counts extracted verbatim from three ICL cohorts.
# NIH 2023  PMID 37133586  n=91 (after exclusion of genetic/acquired causes), 374 person-years
# French    PMID 24646462  n=40
# NIH 2008  PMID 18456875  n=39 enrolled, 36 followed (median 49.5 months)
rec = [
 # phenotype, HPO, cohort, pmid, k, n
 ("HPV-related disease",            "HP:0032152", "NIH 2023",   37133586, 26, 91),
 ("HPV-related disease",            "HP:0032152", "French 2014",24646462, 12, 40),
 ("Cryptococcosis",                 "HP:0032249", "NIH 2023",   37133586, 22, 91),
 ("Molluscum contagiosum",          "HP:0032252", "NIH 2023",   37133586,  8, 91),
 ("Nontuberculous mycobacterial disease","HP:0032257","NIH 2023",37133586, 5, 91),
 ("Any opportunistic infection",    "HP:0002719", "French 2014",24646462, 25, 40),
 ("Any opportunistic infection",    "HP:0002719", "NIH 2008",   18456875, 15, 36),
 ("Autoimmune manifestation",       "HP:0002960", "French 2014",24646462, 14, 40),
 ("Autoimmune manifestation",       "HP:0002960", "NIH 2008",   18456875,  4, 36),
 ("Malignancy",                     "HP:0002664", "French 2014",24646462,  5, 40),
 ("Asymptomatic or mild only",      "-",          "French 2014",24646462,  8, 40),
 ("Asymptomatic or mild only",      "-",          "NIH 2008",   18456875,  7, 39),
 ("Death (any cause, in follow-up)","-",          "NIH 2008",   18456875,  7, 39),
 ("Death attributed to ICL",        "-",          "NIH 2008",   18456875,  4, 39),
]
df = pd.DataFrame(rec, columns=["phenotype","hpo","cohort","pmid","k","n"])
df["p"] = df.k/df.n
lo, hi = stats.beta.ppf(0.025, df.k, df.n-df.k+1), stats.beta.ppf(0.975, df.k+1, df.n-df.k)
df["lo"], df["hi"] = np.nan_to_num(lo, nan=0.0), np.nan_to_num(hi, nan=1.0)

# Pool phenotypes measured in more than one cohort, and test between-cohort heterogeneity
pool = []
for ph, g in df.groupby("phenotype", sort=False):
    K, N = g.k.sum(), g.n.sum()
    l = stats.beta.ppf(0.025, K, N-K+1); h = stats.beta.ppf(0.975, K+1, N-K)
    if len(g) > 1:
        tab = [[int(r.k), int(r.n-r.k)] for r in g.itertuples()]
        chi2, pv, dof, _ = stats.chi2_contingency(np.array(tab))
    else:
        pv = np.nan
    pool.append((ph, g.hpo.iloc[0], K, N, K/N, l, h, pv, len(g)))
P = pd.DataFrame(pool, columns=["phenotype","hpo","k","n","p","lo","hi","p_het","n_cohorts"])
print(P.to_string(index=False, float_format=lambda x: f"{x:.3f}"))

# Mortality rate from the two cohorts that report follow-up time
py_2023 = 374.0           # person-years, 91 patients (PMID 37133586)
py_2008 = 36*49.5/12.0    # 36 patients followed a median 49.5 months (PMID 18456875)
d_2008  = 7
rate = d_2008/py_2008
rl, rh = stats.chi2.ppf(0.025, 2*d_2008)/2/py_2008, stats.chi2.ppf(0.975, 2*(d_2008+1))/2/py_2008
print(f"\nNIH 2008 all-cause mortality: {d_2008} deaths / {py_2008:.0f} person-years "
      f"= {rate*100:.1f} per 100 person-years (95% CI {rl*100:.1f}-{rh*100:.1f})")
print(f"ICL-attributable: 4/{py_2008:.0f} py = {4/py_2008*100:.1f} per 100 py")

# CD4 depth differs markedly between cohorts
print("\nCD4 at diagnosis: NIH 2023 median 80/mm3 (n=91); French 2014 mean 127/mm3, range 4-294 (n=40)")

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(15.5, 6.2))

# Panel A: forest plot of pooled phenotype frequencies
ax = axes[0]
Q = P.sort_values("p")
y = np.arange(len(Q))
cols = ["#6a51a3" if c>1 else "#9e9ac8" for c in Q.n_cohorts]
ax.errorbar(Q.p, y, xerr=[Q.p-Q.lo, Q.hi-Q.p], fmt="o", color="#4a1486",
            ecolor="#9e9ac8", elinewidth=2.2, capsize=3, ms=7)
for i,r in enumerate(Q.itertuples()):
    ax.text(1.02, i, f"{r.k}/{r.n}", va="center", fontsize=8.5, transform=ax.get_yaxis_transform())
ax.set_yticks(y)
ax.set_yticklabels([f"{r.phenotype}" + (f"  [{r.hpo}]" if r.hpo!="-" else "") for r in Q.itertuples()], fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlim(0, 1.0); ax.set_xlabel("frequency among ICL patients (exact 95% CI)")
ax.set_title("A  Pooled phenotype frequencies across three ICL cohorts\n(PMIDs 37133586, 24646462, 18456875)", fontsize=10.5, loc="left")
ax.grid(axis="x", alpha=0.25)

# Panel B: between-cohort heterogeneity for phenotypes measured more than once
ax = axes[1]
H = df[df.phenotype.isin(P[P.n_cohorts>1].phenotype)].copy()
order = ["Any opportunistic infection","Autoimmune manifestation","Asymptomatic or mild only","HPV-related disease"]
H["ord"] = H.phenotype.map({p:i for i,p in enumerate(order)})
H = H.sort_values(["ord","cohort"])
cmap = {"NIH 2023":"#08519c","French 2014":"#d94801","NIH 2008":"#238b45"}
yp, labels, seen = [], [], 0
for i,r in enumerate(H.itertuples()):
    ax.barh(i, r.p, color=cmap[r.cohort], height=0.62)
    ax.errorbar(r.p, i, xerr=[[r.p-r.lo],[r.hi-r.p]], fmt="none", ecolor="#444444", capsize=3, elinewidth=1.3)
    labels.append(f"{r.phenotype}\n{r.cohort} ({r.k}/{r.n})")
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(H))); ax.set_yticklabels(labels, fontsize=7.6)
ax.set_xlim(0,1.0); ax.set_xlabel("frequency")
het = P[P.n_cohorts>1].set_index("phenotype").p_het
txt = "  |  ".join(f"{p.split()[0]} p_het = {het[p]:.3f}" for p in order if p in het.index)
ax.set_title("B  Cohort-to-cohort heterogeneity in phenotype frequency\n" + txt, fontsize=9.5, loc="left")
ax.grid(axis="x", alpha=0.25)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
